title: AutoFly
description: This mod automatically runs /fly when you are on a server. It will verify that you do not have access to flight before attempting to do so.
body:
# Auto Fly
## What does the mod do?
This mod will run the command `/fly` for you, when you first load into a server, and when you change dimensions on the server. It will not run the command if you are actively flying, or have access to fly. Assuming it's working correctly, you will never need to run `/fly` again!


## Why make such a one-off mod?
The server I play on has a bug where `/fly` does not carry between dimensions, I assume I'm not the only one with an issue like this, and may as well share with others.

## Contact
My username on Discord is AlexTheNerd, I usually respond within 12 hours!
